description: i18n violation baseline when i18next/no-literal-string rule is first enabled for owner-console. Main branch had 0 violations because the rule was not enabled. This PR enables the rule and establishes the baseline at 109 violations to prevent future regressions while allowing gradual cleanup via 30/60/90 plan.
notes: frontend-dashboard violations reduced from 260+ to 0 by fixing all i18n violations
owner-console i18next/no-literal-string rule enabled for the first time in this PR
Main branch (origin/main) has 0 violations because the rule was not enabled there
Baseline set to 109 (merge commit count) to reflect the state when rule is first enabled
owner-console ESLint expanded from *.{js,jsx} to *.{js,jsx,ts,tsx} to include TypeScript files
Pre-commit hook will prevent new violations in changed files
CI baseline check will prevent regression (count increases above 109)
